retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic bridal portrait featuring a central figure in a voluminous white gown against a dark architectural background with dynamic falling petals.
triggerTerms: cinematic bridal portrait with falling petals
gothic arch background with white script

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, moody portrait of a bride in an ornate white gown with puff sleeves and a tulle skirt, standing next to a seated man in a white suit, set against a dark stone doorway with white petals suspended in mid-air.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between bright white garments and dark architectural shadows
Dynamic movement of blurred white petals against static subjects
Vertical hierarchy with script text at the top and advisory label at the bottom
Triangular composition formed by the two subjects and the bouquet

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The bride is the primary vertical anchor on the right; the seated man provides a horizontal base on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white bouquet held by the bride acts as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top script down to the bride's face, following the gown's volume to the seated man, then to the advisory label.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the doorway provide negative space that makes the white clothing pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and brown shadows in the background architecture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white in the bridal gown, suit, and falling petals.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and subtle green stems in the bouquet.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall color saturation, leaning toward a monochromatic feel with warm undertones.

letterConstructionRules: High-contrast strokes with thin hair lines and thick swells
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature oversized, circular flourishes
The 'y' descender loops back to underline the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the ornate script with a rigid, blocky sans-serif for technical labels to create a formal vs. functional contrast.
graphicDevices: Parental Advisory label in bottom left corner

avoid: Modern geometric sans-serifs for the title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides similar formal flourishes and elegance

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photo of a bride in a massive white tulle gown and a man in a white suit, posed in a dark stone gothic doorway with white petals falling around them.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white, elegant Spencerian script title at the top center and a standard black and white parental advisory label in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the script white and highly flourished?
Is the background dark enough to make the white gown pop?
Are the falling petals blurred to suggest motion?
Is the advisory label placed in the bottom left?

mustAchieve: Crisp white textures against deep shadows

postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between subjects and background
Ensure script is centered and legible
Verify the presence of motion-blurred petals
Confirm the white suit and dress are not overexposed
recipe.reuseFormula: Cinematic Portrait + High Contrast Lighting + Ornate Script Overlay + Dynamic Particle Elements
